text: {"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'ꝑel' (only) in 'Christo ù ꝑel mehen' is reduced to 'the Son'"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["xitħic û pectzil û lobil û beel (the rumour of his wicked conduct spread) -> 'his evil ways grew worse'", "maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol (the grief of your heart will not end) -> 'you will find no time in your heart'", "ù ɔicil ù Uich (the fierceness of his face) -> 'great majesty in his face'", "noc kixob (a garment of thorns) -> 'crowned with thorns'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii (it is no wonder that I resemble him) -> 'Do not be afraid that I appear to you'", "cici tħan Dioz (good word of God) -> 'holy word of God'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly renders the spreading rumour, the lasting grief and the fierce face, which A gets wrong; B's one clear slip is turning 'no wonder I resemble him' into 'do not be afraid'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'what we think' in the dream clause ('hebal c tucliceex')", "'greatly' (Calam) in 'they love one another'"], "added": ["\"it stops moving as well\"", "\"a prominent scholastic theologian known in Spanish tradition as Enrique de Gante or Enrique Gran\" (the note's identification of Enrique Gran with Henry of Ghent is unsupported and probably false)"], "mistranslated": ["a dream is an image of what we think while eating/sleeping -> \"dreams are delusions that come when we sleep\"", "nor can it be deceived, because it is supremely clear -> \"it cannot deceive because He is supremely clear to all things\" (passive and active conflated)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'the younger' (û chichnile), rendered only as 'One of them'"], "added": ["\"of a well\""], "mistranslated": ["only when you look at yourselves does it really appear -> \"although you see yourself in it, it does not truly come into being\"", "very clear/manifest to you (hach chacan tech) -> \"very like you\"", "or other things for which you turn your backs on the true God -> \"other things that you take for the true God\"", "nor can it be deceived, because it is supremely clear (topzazil) -> \"so it can never fail, for it is the beginning of all things\"", "not created as we and all things were created -> 'all things' moved into 'before heaven and earth and all things existed'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya more closely throughout, apart from a small addition and a speculative note, while B makes several errors of sense in the mirror analogy, the idolatry question and the passage on God's word."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'kahez' (remember) and the sense that greater things will come after the illness is endured", "'caxi hach pachalace' (even if it is very late)"], "added": ["\"Quickly\""], "mistranslated": ["u yanalob àzab nohob (other, greater things will come after you pass through it) -> 'you have had enough of other things already'", "à culpachticoob (pledge to put your sins behind you) -> 'as you confess them'", "noh pahzubtal (great shame) -> 'great condemnation'", "alabolal (hope/faith) -> 'joy'", "caxi (even if) -> 'Perhaps'", "caxi hach pachalace (even if very late) -> 'Quickly'", "God's mercy will see you turned back (S. Bernardo) -> 'he [the Holy Spirit] is the mercy of God'", "hach chacan tiob (appearing very clearly to them) -> 'whose appearance was very like the two who had come before'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'à lolob' (your flowers) in the question about worldly delights"], "added": ["\"pale as a shadow\""], "mistranslated": ["à lolob la kilob (your flowers/delights) -> 'those false friends of yours'", "ɔibolan ti alakoob (coveted by others) -> 'coveted by the women' (doubtful)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the brother's exhortation closely ('remember', 'renounce', 'even if very late', 'hope', God's mercy seeing the penitent), but A misreads several of these passages and adds 'Quickly'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["yokol ú noh celembal (upon his great youthful form) -> \"on his great shoulder\"", "ca talel tu pazel hunꝑel h numya, y ú yabal Zakcil hebixten (come to visit a sufferer full of misery like me) -> \"come to the house of a wretched man with such brightness\"", "ú alabolal ah Zatalob (hope of the lost) -> \"glory of the lost\"", "tan à chaibenzic ú yabal tibil beob ichil lay Kinlae (doing many good deeds in these days) -> \"ask pardon of the many good people of this time\"", "ú muKob ú Kabilob toh pulKeban (confession's strength and its hands/power) -> \"the power of the medicine of confession\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ca tuyilah y ú yah ɔaiatzilich (the sick man saw him and his merciful face) -> \"looked upon him with tender mercy\", which makes the Spirit the one looking", "cu ualKezic ú yich (turns aside his face/countenance) -> \"turning aside the anger\", which is loose"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the youth, the visit, the hope of the lost and the good deeds right, while A misreads several key phrases (shoulder, brightness, glory, asking pardon of good people)."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'only' (uꝑel) in 'the only Son of God came down' is dropped"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["lay ú cha campahal ta Uuyahexloe (this explanation/teaching you have heard) -> 'these appearances you have heard about took place'", "Ca inàc Zazil ti c nateex (so that light may enter our understanding) -> 'so that there may be light in our understanding' (slight weakening)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["cu yuchul lay ú cha campahal ta Uuyahexloe -> 'This comes to pass through the teaching you have heard' (sense loosely rendered)", "ma ú katob (they do not ask for / seek) -> 'they do not wish for' (slight shift)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations are complete and close to the source, but B renders the opening clause about the teaching more plausibly and keeps 'only Son', while A garbles that clause as 'appearances' and drops 'only'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["puɔcéex ti le káaxóob 'flee to the forests' -> 'flee to the mountains' (the Maya paraphrase says forests, not the Latin's mountains)", "opening clause 'cá uohléex tu hahil' ('when you truly know') -> 'so that we truly understand'", "ti zeƀchilah / má ƀin anac ú macunzaƀal ú tħanóob heƀic alahanóob ti iké: the sense of how his words are to be taken is loosely rendered as 'his words will not be cast aside as if spoken to the wind'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Ahzáat-zah c zipiléex 'Pardoner of our sins' -> 'our offended Savior'", "ú hokolil á uolah 'fulfilment of your will' -> 'the honor of your will'", "ma unchacóoƀ ú helel 'not rest' -> 'not turn away' (doubtful)", "cú nahmaticóob humpel hach pelelil ɔá uol 'deserve very earnest attention' -> 'signify something very grave'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but B gets the key title Ahzáat-zah ('Pardoner of our sins') wrong and also misrenders 'fulfilment of your will', while A's slips are fewer and smaller."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["c paymaéex tħanicéex ('that you should call promptly'; the speaker is not urging anyone) -> 'we urge you to call promptly'", "cħiczic ù chucáanil (roughly 'completes or brings to fullness') -> 'fills the measure of guilt', which is slightly interpretive"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["the image of the 'many hands' God holds out (ƀahunóob ticħóob), reduced to 'further offers'", "the mud or mire in which the fallen sinner stays lying (téel luké)"], "added": ["\"turned aside and ready to depart\"", "\"Great is the ingratitude you show him\""], "mistranslated": ["out of weakness and frailty rather than obstinacy (hach utzilil iix ɔoyanil, emá chichpolal) -> 'a very good and loving thing, without great difficulty'", "the great force of temptation rather than deliberate contempt -> 'a firm trial, without thought of resisting'", "great vulnerability to another rather than freedom of one's own will -> 'great strength, without opposition of the will'", "staying wallowing in the mud -> 'turned aside and ready to depart'", "as many days as we stay estranged from God without asking pardon, so much more unworthy we make ourselves before him -> 'How often have you rejected the grace of God without asking for pardon? Great is the ingratitude you show him'", "restored to life by confession (cuxtaƀal le confesaré) -> 'before going to confession'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A gets the contrasts (weakness vs obstinacy, force of temptation vs contempt, falling and rising vs staying in the mud) and the 'as many days' argument right, while B garbles several of these passages into different meanings."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["of its forebears"], "mistranslated": ["see whether this very experience/habit does not confirm it -> 'whether experience itself does not confirm this' (acceptable; listed only for comparison with B)", "the hands hang down, the eyes close (kaƀóob cú luƀulóob, pacatóob cú kalicuƀaóob) -> 'the sins into which it falls, the glances it allows itself'", "it must be dragged as if hauled; or out of habit they turn their backs on prayers and devotions -> 'until it seems to drag itself along, if out of habit it still keeps up the pious devotions'", "words, means and deeds that give off a foul stench -> 'works that give bad example' (interpretive)", "so that it is loathed and rejected -> 'it becomes a cause of scandal and of envy'", "shame arises and everything is turned into it -> 'The world, vanity, and everything that changes with them'", "the worms of a corrupt life teem -> 'the delights of this passing life'", "everything ends in a mockery of a Christian (cheh ƀacilil) -> 'a complete coldness as a Christian'", "nothing is seen that shows signs of the soul's former beauty -> 'Nothing else is seen in it but the marks of the soul's former beauty' (sense reversed)", "how exceedingly difficult it is for the soul to return to its former state -> 'what a misfortune it is that the soul is turned away from what it once was'", "even if it costs many pains and days (yaƀalóob yailóob iix kinilé) -> 'a few pains and days would set it right'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["see whether this very experience does not confirm it -> 'See now whether, if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle'", "out of habit (napzah) -> 'because of neglect' (minor)", "how very difficult (hach canil) -> rendered acceptably, but 'unless they quickly call' slightly shifts the conditional (minor)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely (hands hanging, eyes closing, a wooden log, worms, a mockery of a Christian, many pains and days), while A misreads many key phrases, reverses the sense in places and adds 'of its forebears'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["offended (in 'Our offended Savior' and 'our offended Savior')"], "mistranslated": ["Ahzáat-zahuléex / Ahzáat-zah zipiléex (Redeemer; Forgiver of sins) -> 'offended Savior'", "In heláancuntah bahun leytiá (how he changed/dealt with this) -> 'was greatly angered at this'", "tu pulah tancab ti le kulna (cast them out into the temple courtyard) -> 'drove everything out of the temple'", "hach nanacilóob ti hach nohochil hatzul ti le kulnaéex (very widespread in the greater part of your churches) -> 'stand out as very great offenses in the temple'", "ti cá unchaci tioklal napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex (so that it may serve for correction of what you recognize) -> 'what has happened through custom or through ignorance'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Má á ɔáic á uoléex (not giving your will) -> 'Not giving your hearts'", "ti máax cú talel ú ɔá zipil (others to whom you come to give sin) -> 'whereby occasions of sin arise' (the agency is softened)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya closely, including the courtyard, the epithets and the 'greater part of your churches' clause, while A adds 'offended' and misreads several clauses."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["heƀic yumtzil iix ah yacunah (addressing the hearers: 'sirs and beloved ones') -> 'like a loving lord and father' (wrongly applied to God)", "cà má c paymaéex kaholticéex (a warning that we not be slow to recognize it) -> 'whom we do not first recognize'", "ti tulacal ù nummia hach yaé (in all his very painful afflictions) -> 'in all their grievous afflictions'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["cú cilƀa, iix cù xiƀil ú kikel (the soul trembles and the blood runs cold)", "naklic (resting, said of the Samaritan woman at the well)"], "added": ["'show irreverence'", "'by the thought that'"], "mistranslated": ["máac cú hochic iix cú tzolic ti nucul cá leti uol hach heɔáan (those who explain it so that the soul, utterly terrified...) -> 'the very firm thought being spoken of here'", "zeƀchilah (in haste) -> 'in parable'", "Ahzáat-zah zipiléex (Forgiver of your sins) -> 'offended Savior'", "tiƀilƀeilóob (good ways, virtues) -> 'affronts'", "nuculilóob hakoƀilóob (wondrous teachings) -> 'great sorrows'", "ú pocħol Dios (the profaning of God) -> 'kindles God's wrath'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the Maya closely, with only a few small slips; B gets several key terms wrong (haste, Forgiver of sins, virtues) and drops the image of trembling and blood running cold."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé (masters should treat servants as/like children of God) -> 'Just as God acts toward His children' (makes God the actor, which the source does not say)", "ti laóobé (serve God in them) -> 'through them' (slight shift)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["chucanil ('completely/entirely' in 'what does it forbid entirely') is not rendered"], "added": ["\"loves\" (in 'as Christ loves the Church'; the source just says 'like the Church and Christ')"], "mistranslated": ["hebic le iglesia y Cristo (like the Church and Christ) -> 'as Christ loves the Church' (adds the verb love)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both are complete and close, but B renders the masters/servants answer ('as children of God') more faithfully than A, which makes God the one acting, while B's own slips are smaller."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["Mayli cú nahaltic ('rather, he gains merit') -> 'No, as long as they do not consent'", "le xmá tiblil ('immodesty / bad conduct') -> 'Idleness'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["with full consent"], "mistranslated": ["c meyahtbaóob ('our occupying ourselves in work') -> 'our pious devotions'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly renders the key answer 'rather he gains merit' (Ripalda's 'antes merece'), which A turns into a consent condition, and A also misreads xmá tiblil as idleness; B's errors are smaller: it adds 'with full consent' and renders the work phrase as 'pious devotions'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'nucul' (great/grave) qualifying the harm in the first answer"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["bin ɔocanacti ú tohpultic ú keban (will confessing his sin be enough?) -> 'will they be forgiven by confessing their sin?'", "cú ɔanuculinte hebic unchacé (he must hold the intention to do it when he can) -> 'They must strive to do it as soon as possible'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["'worldly' (riches)"], "mistranslated": ["x má xulilóob (rendering uncertain) -> 'endless vain words', an over-specific gloss"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B is more accurate: it keeps 'notable harm', 'is it enough to confess', and 'keep the intention'; A turns these into looser paraphrases."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'tu beil' (in a right way) in the first question is not fully rendered as a separate qualifier"], "added": ["\"of the Law\""], "mistranslated": ["is it a sin to desire riches for a good end and in a right way -> \"other than for a good purpose\" (the question's conditions are turned into an exception)", "with greed/avarice (taɔmanzahóob) -> \"through dishonest means\"", "by a separate commandment (pelelil almahtħan) -> \"by these commandments\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"are forbidden\" (in the first answer)"], "mistranslated": ["because evil thoughts and inclinations arise from them -> \"the inner thoughts and impulses behind them are themselves evil\"", "to make God's commandments clearer (zazilcuntic) -> \"so that we may better fulfill the commandments of God\"", "desiring them not in the right way, and with greed -> \"disordered desires and greed\" (loose)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "B renders the first question more accurately, but A gets the causal answer and the 'make clearer' purpose of the Church's commandments right, which B mistranslates, so A is slightly more faithful overall."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["often"], "mistranslated": ["'Bahun ti ú yabal misa' (since Mass has been mentioned / spoken of) -> 'Since you hear Mass often'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["'Ti máax cú nahinticóob le misaóob' (for whom are the Masses offered) -> 'Whom do these Masses benefit?'", "'zut-zah yacunahóob' (his favours / benefits) -> 'in return of love' (loose)", "'tulul tzic' (wholly obey) -> 'supreme reverence' (loose)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations are complete with only small errors of sense, but A renders the questions and answers more precisely and only slips on the 'Since Mass is spoken of' clause, while B misreads the offering question and paraphrases loosely in a few places."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["pa ꜭhavomariçabal hay (Purgatory as a house of purification/suffering, in apposition) -> \"or in the hospital\"", "ꜭhupam ruꜫitahic hun vinak (at the point of a person's death/end) -> \"in visiting a person\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ra hilaxic paru vi / tahilax paru vi (its being read/pronounced over one) -> \"receives absolution upon oneself\" / \"One is absolved upon oneself\"", "ni ma coꜭhih vi vinak (the person greatly receives/benefits) -> \"will truly be cleansed\" (marked unclear)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but A gets two important passages wrong: it calls Purgatory \"the hospital\" and turns the deathbed situation into \"visiting a person\", while B's errors are smaller and only affect the wording about reading or absolution."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["is giving absolution"], "mistranslated": ["tu coꜭhih (it is accomplished or fulfilled for one) -> \"he shall take patience\"", "ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux (fervent, warm or hot of heart) -> \"proud, hard-hearted\"", "ah biꜯ, ah ahil ꜭhiroꜫexic (sorrowful or lamenting, eager to weep) -> \"songsters, merrymakers, weeping\"", "tan ti giꜯ ruçaꜭh Padre (before the face of the Father) -> \"while the Father Priest is giving absolution\"", "ru vaꜭh (its fruit or effect) -> \"its presence\"", "ki ti vagaxah ꜭhipe ru ꜭhoh mil (we must know how it is to be used or done) -> \"you should hear concerning its proper benefit\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhibiꜯ (with song or lament; uncertain) -> \"with sorrow\" (possible slip)", "ha ahoxel ti ka ban penitençia (then it is fitting that we do penance) -> \"and then we do penance\" (loses the sense of obligation)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the source closely, reading the heart terms and the clause about weeping for sins correctly, while A turns the penitent's fervour and sorrow into pride and merrymaking and adds absolution, which is not in the source."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhi ruꜫatatibal ga ka gux (with the burning/warming, i.e. fervour, of our hearts) -> \"with the contrition <gloss>breaking</gloss> of our hearts\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"and taken away\""], "mistranslated": ["haga ti katoh beh (so that we may pay/make satisfaction for it) -> \"so that we may be helped\"", "ti ka gexer taçibeh ri ꜭhin ri ka ga çom mac (that we may exchange/commute our gathered sins) -> \"so that we may receive forgiveness for our sins\"", "ti gex va ꜭhi bex ... ꜭhiru pokonariçabal (eternal death is exchanged into its suffering, i.e. commuted to temporal punishment) -> \"changed and taken away is this everlasting death, with its suffering\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A keeps the penitential logic of payment and commutation (toh, gexer, gex), and its only clear slip is 'contrition/breaking' for the warming or fervour of the heart; B blurs payment into 'help' and 'forgiveness' and adds 'taken away' to the commutation."}

'for indeed there one would... (continues)' -> 'And it is now received from this.'", "first-person plural 'we' (kamac, kumal) -> third-person 'someone/they' in the conditional clause"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["meta claim that the previous page reads 'with its suffering, with its...' (cannot be checked from this page)"], "mistranslated": ["vaue ni gahçak 'here on earth' -> just 'here' (small slip)", "the exact items in the penitential list (ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij) are uncertain and B's 'mortification of our bodies' is a guess"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the source closely, including the key point that the one who pays for their sins will not go to purgatory, while A calls purgatory a 'house of torment', makes up phrases, and gets the closing sentences wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["the previous page ended \"For indeed there one would\" (meta note states the previous page's wording, which cannot be checked from this page)"], "mistranslated": ["ꜫobal, hoyevabal (payment/satisfaction and mercy) -> \"help and deliverance\" (loose)", "ꜭhivi ꜭhin / ꜭhiki ꜭhin (to them) -> \"to you\" (person uncertain)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["vae tan tihath (\"this is now received\") is merged into \"offered and granted\" and not rendered separately"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhupam ca ca huna (within/for two years) -> \"every two years\" (slight shift)"]}, "better": "tie", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page with only small slips: A guesses at the previous page in its meta note and renders ꜫobal/hoyevabal loosely, while B folds the opening phrase of the second part into a paraphrase and says \"every two years\" where the page says \"within two years\"."}
